paras: Application: BMW F8x M2, M3, M4 — M Performance & M Sport Rear Brake Systems Part Number: PPS.1313.01.050

Paragon's PPS1313 Titanium Brake Pad Shims are precision-engineered thermal barriers designed for high-performance and track use on BMW F8x M2, M3, and M4 platforms. Fitted between the brake pad backing plate and caliper piston, these shims dramatically reduce heat transfer into the caliper and brake fluid — one of the most common causes of brake fade and spongy pedal feel under sustained hard braking.
